$:set -eu
cd workspaces/codespace-terminal-mcp
npm install --no-audit --no-fund >/dev/null
node --check oauth.mjs
node --check http-server.mjs
PORT=39775 MCP_ALLOWED_GITHUB_LOGIN=BestNameYet MCP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN=https://shiny-robot-3000.app.github.dev MCP_GH_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID=test-client MCP_GH_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET=test-secret node http-server.mjs >/tmp/mcp-check.log 2>&1 &
pid=$!
trap 'kill $pid 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
sleep 2
printf 'DISCOVERY: '
curl -sS -o /tmp/mcp-discovery.json -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:39775/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server
python3 -m json.tool /tmp/mcp-discovery.json | head -20
printf 'UNAUTHENTICATED: '
curl -sS -o /tmp/mcp-denied.json -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}' http://127.0.0.1:39775/mcp
cat /tmp/mcp-denied.json
printf '\nLOGS: '
cat /tmp/mcp-check.log
